context: A boss reviews a property registration plan
purpose: Teach: 役人/図っ/担う/立案/当方/所管/登記/全額

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Clipped, direct opening. Eyes forward. No warmth in the efficiency — this is business. Expects a straight answer.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 当方の担当が立案を担う形で、書類を準備しています。
lines.en: Our team is handling the planning stage and preparing the documents.
lines.style: Steady, professional tone. Even pace, slightly formal register. No defensiveness, just facts. The tone of someone who's already thought this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役人との折衝、円滑に図ってくれ。
lines.en: Make sure the negotiations with the administration go smoothly.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Slight weight on the instruction itself — this matters. Brief, clipped at the end. Not a question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。所管の窓口、明日訪問予定です。
lines.en: Yes. We're scheduled to visit the office in charge tomorrow.
lines.style: Respectful, confirming. No elaboration — just the essential update. Controlled, slightly formal in register. Slightly faster than conversational.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 費用は全額、今月の予算から落とせるか?
lines.en: Can we cover the full cost from this month's budget?
lines.style: Careful, probing question. Slight pause before the question lands. Not accusing, but testing whether the plan is actually solid. Lean forward slightly in posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Clipped, confident. No hesitation. Slightly faster delivery — shows he's prepared for this. The reply of someone who did the homework.
